title: Microsoft Viva: Cowork adoption and impact in the Consumption Dashboard and Copilot Dashboard
summary: The briefing's roadmap facts, licensing prerequisites, privacy controls and reporting details are supported. It appropriately reports the documentation's disagreements about manager access, delegation and export maturity; the identification route could clarify that a policy must then be added.

claims.claim: Consumption Dashboard export offers daily and weekly user-level credit metrics.
claims.quote:
You can download user-level credit usage (AI cost) metrics using the Consumption Dashboard's data export feature.

claims.quote:
Total Copilot Credits used | number
Session count | number
User limit | number
Spending policy limit | number

claims.claim: The consumption query cannot add other metric categories.
claims.quote: You can't add other metric categories. To remove a metric, select the "X" on it.

claims.claim: Consumption queries are grouped by week by default.
claims.quote: By default, consumption queries are grouped by week.

claims.claim: Daily query grouping is configured through More Settings under Description and Group by set to Day.
claims.quote:
To change this to day or month, select More Settings under the Description box.
More settings: Next to Group by, select Day.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; Risk assessment; Governance controls; summary
claims.claim: A dedicated VFAM policy governs identification and identified outputs in Consumption Dashboard insights and export.
claims.quote:
Identification is available for the following Viva Insights features: Consumption Dashboard data export and Consumption Dashboard insights
Access is governed by a dedicated Viva Feature Access Management (VFAM) policy

claims.claim: Only a Microsoft 365 Global Administrator or AI Administrator can create and manage identification policies.
claims.quote: Only a Microsoft 365 Global Administrator or an AI Administrator can create and manage identification access policies.

claims.claim: Identification policies are reached in Microsoft 365 admin center through Settings > Org settings > Viva feature access > Viva Insights > identification feature.
claims.quote: Go to Settings > Org settings > Viva feature access, select Viva Insights, choose the identification feature, and add a policy.
claims.fix: Keep the documented route and append this instruction to the row note: 'After choosing the identification feature, add a policy.' The cited page gives this final policy-creation step.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId <FeatureId> -Name <PolicyName> -IsFeatureEnabled $true enables the selected Viva feature by policy.

$true: The feature is enabled by the policy.
Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights

claims.claim: Advanced analysis, including consumption queries, requires at least 50 assigned Viva Insights service-plan licences.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The 50-licence threshold can combine Microsoft Copilot and Viva Insights licences.
claims.quote: For example, 30 assigned Microsoft Copilot licenses (which include the Viva Insights service plan) + 20 assigned Viva Insights licenses = 50 assigned Viva Insights licenses.

claims.claim: The Copilot Dashboard guide permits business or enterprise Microsoft 365 or Office 365 customers with an active Exchange Online account.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Copilot Dashboard in Viva Insights is available to any customer with a Microsoft 365 or Office 365 subscription for business or enterprise, and who has an active Exchange Online account.

claims.claim: The Copilot Dashboard guide specifies 50 assigned Viva Insights licences or one assigned Copilot licence for data processing, differing from the environment guide's 50-licence dashboard requirement.
claims.quote: A minimum of 50 assigned Viva Insights licenses, or 1 assigned Copilot license (including the Viva Insights service plan), is required for data processing to kick off.

claims.quote: Copilot Credits are the common currency for eligible Microsoft services with usage-based billing.

Sign in to the Viva Insights Admin portal with your admin credentials.
On the left, select Settings, then Manager settings.

claims.claim: An automation operation for the manager consumption-access setting is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Insights manager settings Consumption insights configure API Microsoft Graph PowerShell; Consumption insights Graph PowerShell manager settings. Read manager settings, dashboard settings, Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy; no API found for the manager consumption setting.

claims.claim: A Viva Insights Administrator or AI admin configures manager settings.
claims.quote:
Applies to: Viva Insights Administrator, AI admin
As a Viva Insights Administrator or AI admin, you can set up and edit Manager settings

claims.claim: Managers must meet the configured Minimum team size, which must be at least five.
claims.quote: Only managers whose team size meets or exceeds the Minimum team size setting can access insights in the Viva Insights web app. The minimum team size must be set to at least five.

claims.claim: The team-size count includes the manager.
claims.quote: Team size includes: The manager; All employees who directly report to the manager; All employees who indirectly report to the manager through the organizational reporting hierarchy

claims.claim: Managers cannot be granted consumption insights without also being granted Copilot insights.
claims.quote: You can't grant managers scoped access to Consumption insights if you don't grant them access to Copilot insights.

claims.claim: Manager-setting changes apply after one hour.
claims.quote: Changes to these settings will apply after one hour.

claims.claim: The manager consumption setting grants team-scoped dashboard and export access, subject to the export page's current role limitation.
claims.quote: Optionally, select Grant managers scoped access to Consumption insights. When you select this, you'll allow managers with the minimum team size to access their team-scoped data in the Consumption Dashboard and export data.

claims.claim: Turning off the Viva Insights web app control disables the whole app, including Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports and advanced analysis.
claims.quote: Turning this control off disables the entire app, which includes the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports, and advanced analysis and admin tools.

claims.claim: A unified exclusion list governs exclusion from aggregated Consumption Dashboard insights.
claims.quote: Your organization might want to exclude certain users from being included in the aggregated insights in the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Agent Dashboard, Consumption Dashboard, or Viva Insights behavior collaboration reports
